name: suede-code-grader
description: Suede Labs AI blunt A-F ship grade for a code change across correctness, security and permissions, data and state, domain truth, UX and release behavior, tests and verification, and deploy readiness, with Instant-F triggers and evidence-based grade caps on auth, payment, migration, and public-API surfaces. Use when asked to grade this, give it a letter, is this an A, how ready is this to ship, or should this merge — when the caller wants the verdict without a findings list. NOT FOR: findings, ev
author: JasonColapietro
summary_zh: 一款为代码变更给出A-F上线评级的AI评审工具，适合快速判断改动是否可以合并或发布。
